message.content:
**The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night, Volume V** is the fifth volume of Richard Francis Burton’s English translation of *The Arabian Nights*, first published in **1885**.[1][4] It is also cataloged as *The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night — Volume 05 (of 10)*.[1]

If you meant a different “Volume V” edition, Burton also produced the related **Supplemental Nights** series, which later continued beyond the original ten volumes.[5]
